description: Get recommendations for what task to work on next. Returns tasks prioritized by: 1) Your in-progress work, 2) Tasks assigned to you, 3) High-priority unassigned tasks.

epicId.description: Optional: filter recommendations to tasks in a specific epic

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return (default 5, max 20)

workspaceId.description: Optional when this repo is bound to a workspace (bind_workspace).

name: recommend_task
